description: This is a JUnit test class for the CredentialsMessageFilter component in the Eclipse Hono project. It contains unit tests verifying that the CredentialsMessageFilter correctly validates AMQP messages based on message structure, content, and expected fields as per the credentials message specification.

classes.name: CredentialsMessageFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for verifying the behavior of the CredentialsMessageFilter class, ensuring it correctly filters AMQP messages according to the credentials message format and required message attributes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a ResourceIdentifier target before each test.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForMissingBody
methods.description: Tests that a message without a body fails the verification filter.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForNonDataSectionBody
methods.description: Tests that a message with a body that is not a Data section, e.g., AmqpValue, fails the filter.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForMissingCorrelationId
methods.description: Ensures that messages missing a message-id or correlation-id fail the verification process.

methods.name: testVerifyFailsForUnknownAction
methods.description: Verifies that messages with an unrecognized action/subject do not pass the filter.

methods.name: testVerifySucceedsForValidGetAction
methods.description: Confirms that a correctly formed message with a valid GET action and appropriate structure passes the verification.

methods.name: givenAValidMessageWithoutBody
methods.description: Helper method that creates a sample message with a specified CredentialsAction, setting basic message properties.
